words.sense: Unreasonably sparing with money or resources, even when doing so is unfair or mean.
misconceptions: Treats any low spending as automatically sensible.

words.sense: Economical and careful about spending without unreasonable deprivation.
misconceptions: Treats any low spending as automatically sensible.

semantic_axes.description: Parsimonious thrift withholds resources unreasonably; frugal thrift avoids waste while meeting legitimate needs.

edges.boundary_rule: Parsimonious thrift withholds resources unreasonably; frugal thrift avoids waste while meeting legitimate needs.

misconceptions.M2: Treats any low spending as automatically sensible.
misconceptions.M3: Ignores harm or fairness when evaluating refusal to spend.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Hira’s lunch habit?

beats.text: Hira cooks rice and vegetables in batches instead of buying lunch every day.
beats.decisive_clue: plans affordable meals without sacrificing needs
beats.reason: The first beat supplies the deciding evidence: plans affordable meals without sacrificing needs.

beats.text: She also packs the food in a container she has used for years.
beats.decisive_clue: plans affordable meals without sacrificing needs
beats.reason: A reused container does not turn sensible economy into meanness.

chains.feedback_short: Plans affordable meals without sacrificing needs — the later detail does not change that distinction.
chains.feedback_deep: Parsimonious means unreasonably sparing with money or resources, even when doing so is unfair or mean. Frugal means economical and careful about spending without unreasonable deprivation. Here, plans affordable meals without sacrificing needs; a reused container does not turn sensible economy into meanness.
